description: Arithmetic on entered numbers only: sum up to 100 entered monthly debt payments and divide by positive gross monthly income. Shows the sum and ratio percentage, rounded half up to two decimal places, with no comparison bands or classification. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Gross monthly income before deductions in USD, at most two decimal places.

monthlyDebts.description: Entered monthly payments, not debt balances. Empty array means zero payments. The sum must be at most USD 100000000.

items.description: Monthly payment in USD, at most two decimal places.

name: debt_to_income

outputSchema.description: monthlyDebts array, debtCount, totalMonthlyDebts and grossMonthlyIncome in USD. ratioPercent is an exact two-decimal percentage string, preserving large ratios across MCP float rounding. Formula: sum of monthly debt payments / gross monthly income * 100.

title: Debt-to-Income Ratio Calculator
